entry_item.definition: [= obuγara- , oburu-] v. i. and t. To pay attention; to be[come] aware or conscious of, take notice of, to apprehend, grasp

example.unicode: ᠪᠢ ᠲᠡᠭᠦᠨ ᠤ ᠦᠭᠡ ᠎ᠶᠢ ᠣᠪᠠᠶᠢᠷᠠᠭᠰᠠᠨ ᠦᠭᠡᠢ
example.transcript: bi tegyn y yge ji --γsan ygei
example.definition: I did not pay attention to what he said.
